narrative.northStar: Laboratory software, not a product dashboard
narrative.overview: Explicit user correction replaces the initial rounded calibration-workbench design. The reference is the functional directness of established engineering desktop software: plain menus, short toolbars, equipment lists, numeric instruments, and a status bar. This is an original implementation of those conventions, not a copied vendor skin.
keyCharacteristics: Full-window working area; minimal application branding.
Dense neutral chrome and plain equipment lists.
Flat, compact instrument faces rather than floating UI cards.
Terse operational text; model explanations available on demand.

rules.name: The Functional Color Rule
rules.body: Color must identify selection, connection, polarity or state. It is not a reward for clicking a button.

dos: Do prioritize workspace area, compact commands and readable measurements.
Do use plain names such as Equipment, Inspector, Data table, and Model.
Do preserve keyboard operation, visible focus, Escape, undo and explicit units.
Do keep technical diagnostics accurate and model limitations available on demand.
donts: Don't reintroduce slogans, coaching questions, motivational empty states or default lesson cards.
Don't restore rounded floating cards, decorative shadows, large logos or a marketing header.
Don't add dead menu commands for unimplemented instruments/physics.
Don't copy vendor assets, front panels, branding, source or proprietary exercises.
